title: The Hating Game
author: Sally Thorne
summary: Two assistants at a merged publishing house sit facing each other and have turned their mutual dislike into a daily game of petty point-scoring. When a promotion puts them in direct competition, the rivalry gets sharper and more personal.
readIf: you love office rivalries, quick banter and a hero who is a lot softer than he first appears.
skipIf: you want a deeper, slower emotional story, as this one stays light and quick on its feet.

pairings.reason: Shares the quarrelling-colleagues energy and keeps the tone just as warm and humorous.
Another workplace-adjacent rivalry romance in publishing, with a bit more emotional depth underneath.
Also a rivals-to-lovers story full of banter, with a larger and more glamorous setting.
